application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding weighted-Haar Hilbert round was rechecked before edits; all retained proof hashes and axiom sets remain unchanged.

Negating one nonroot cube input negates the actual mixed dual. Positive degree supplies a nonempty vertex, proving symmetry and zero membership of the actual convex hull. The degree-zero hull is not incorrectly asserted to be symmetric.

A general span induction proves that every vector in the span of a convex symmetric set containing zero is a nonnegative scalar multiple of a member. The zero coefficient case is handled without division by zero.
Actual Hilbert generators are convex, symmetric and contain zero, using the existing linear completion map and actual representative arithmetic.

Every algebraic-span vector receives a pointwise uniformly bounded representative, with one bound shared by all stages and cells, and a cellwise scaled-dual-hull representation. This is stronger than a bound only in the L2 seminorm.

Metric closure yields representatives approximating every vector of the closed dual subspace. The bound can depend on the vector and error tolerance: unit-bounded projection or clipping preservation is not yet established.
Nine theorems are audited. Characteristic-factor localization, clipping closure, relative orthogonality of different subgroup factors, higher-order concatenation and full Bessel remain unproved.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Mixed dual recursion, covariance and exact subgroup-shift expansions are now established. Same-subgroup mixed-dual finite products now have an exact averaged dual representation and retain weighted anti-uniformity. The actual unit-input mixed-dual convex hull now has multiplicative and translation closure with unchanged weighted anti-uniform bounds. For varying finite groups and cell types, the exact weighted Haar Hilbert realization and vanishing-Gowers/closed-dual-span orthogonality equivalence are now proved. The dual Hilbert span now has uniformly bounded scaled-hull representatives dense in its closure; their bound may depend on the approximation. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
